profile_text.body:
Salesforce is a public company founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker CRM. Its most recent 10-K, for the period ending 2026-01-31, reports revenue of $41,525,000,000. The material harvested from its site is Slack's AI features page, which describes AI in Slack as a way to summarize channels and threads, search files, take meeting notes, translate conversations, and build automations, with Slackbot described as a personal AI agent in Slack that understands the user and the workspace.

The AI products tracked for the company are Slack AI, Tableau AI (Einstein), and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce. Slack's page states that Slack is the conversational UI for Agentforce, and that agents built with Agentforce can run in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages, allowing users to query data, get contextual responses, and trigger actions. It also states that customer data is not used to train large language models and that LLM providers do not have access to customer data, with the models hosted inside Slack's AWS virtual private cloud. According to the page, AI features are available across all paid Slack plans.

Six MCP servers are associated with Salesforce, covering administration and management, SOQL queries against a Salesforce org, and planning deploys, opening pull requests, and triggering pipelines from an AI client. The company's recorded litigation exposure is in California, with 281 cases.
